scripts.build: node -e "console.error('ERROR: Do not deploy directly from workspace root! Use npm run deploy:all.'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.deploy:all: dart run tool/optimize_assets.dart && flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons && npm run pages:deploy
scripts.build:web:optimized: dart run tool/optimize_assets.dart && flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons
scripts.pages:prepare: dart run tool/copy_web_shell_assets.dart && dart run tool/prepare_cloudflare_deploy.dart
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:prepare && npx wrangler pages deploy build/cloudflare-deploy --project-name domacimarket --branch main
scripts.validate:assetlinks: node -e "const content = require('fs').readFileSync('web/.well-known/assetlinks.json', 'utf8'); const data = JSON.parse(content); if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) throw new Error('assetlinks.json must be a non-empty array');"
